description: Generate Random API Key for Access Keys - Add a button to generate secure random alphanumeric keys when adding Access Keys

userStories.title: Implement generateRandomKey function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a function that generates a cryptographically secure 32-character alphanumeric key.
acceptanceCriteria: Function returns a 32-character string using characters A-Z, a-z, 0-9
Function uses crypto.getRandomValues() for secure randomness
Function is exported for use in the modal

userStories.title: Add Generate button to Access Key modal
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a Generate button next to the API key input field when adding an Access Key.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify openAddKeyModal() to conditionally render Generate button when type === 'access'
Button appears next to the API Key input field
Button uses existing btn btn-secondary styling
Button does NOT appear for Gemini, Claude, or Codex key modals
Clicking button calls generateRandomKey() and sets input value
Input field gains focus after key generation
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add visual feedback on key generation
userStories.description: As a user, I want visual feedback when a key is generated so I know the action was successful.
acceptanceCriteria: Input field briefly highlights (e.g., border color change) when key is generated
Generated key is immediately visible in the input field
Animation/highlight uses CSS transition (no jarring effects)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
